questionText:
Match the styling parameter in List I with its rendering effect in List II:

List I:
(A) linestyle=':'
(B) linestyle='--'
(C) marker='^'
(D) linewidth=3

List II:
(I) Renders a dotted line style
(II) Renders a dashed line style
(III) Renders triangle-up markers at data points
(IV) Sets the thickness of the line to 3 points

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
':' is dotted, '--' is dashed, '^' is triangle-up marker, and linewidth sets line thickness in points.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: The s.ndim attribute of any Pandas Series always evaluates to 1 because a Series is inherently a one-dimensional data structure.
Statement II: The s.size attribute returns the total count of elements present in the Series, including missing (NaN) values.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies that both statements contain factual errors.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. Series dimensionality is always 1; s.size counts all elements including NaNs.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
